description: This policy setting allows you to determine whether Settings Agentic search experience is available for users on their device. When the policy is enabled, the agentic experience will not be available, limiting search results to statically indexed searches and semantic searches. When the policy is disabled, users will have Settings Agent search experience available on their device.
